Name: Pastel Foliage
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
Do you wish you had more color to your trees? Do you play with A Blue Grass Recolor or another pastel recolor and wish your trees could match better? MAYBE you just like the idea of pastel trees in your game...

Well you've come to the right place! This AT pack adds several pastel recolors for each of the in game "regular" trees, aka oak, pine, maple, mahogany, palm and mushroom trees.

Credit to A[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164]zrashar[/url] for their amazingly gorgeous simple foliage mod which I used as the base for these recolors (permission provided on their mod page).

Preview images are taken in game using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10635]A Blue Grass Recolor[/url] for reference

[b][size=4]v1.0.3 UPDATE[/size][/b] - so I wasn't happy with the maple and pine trees so they've been re-worked to have better contrast. While doing this, I had some fun making some darker but still colorful versions so I decided to add those in too! They add some nice variety for magical plkaythroughs IMO so I hope you like them! If you prefer the older versions of the maple/pine, I will leave the file in the archive so you can access it.  New previews are taken with a more traditional recolor so you can see the colors in comparison to green grass.

[b]In the works:[/b] I have permission to pastel-ify both Raffadax and NintheCactus's More Trees so hopefully those will be released in the next several weeks!
